Class PheromoneOffHeapGrid

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.core.simulation.gpu.PheromoneOffHeapGrid
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class PheromoneOffHeapGrid extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Off-Heap Direct Memory Manager for 3D Pheromone Grids. Allocates native off-heap memory outside the Java Garbage Collector heap, preventing GC pauses when simulating dense multi-million cell terrariums.
